title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.22082v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document. Compared with function-level code generation, this task demands longer planning horizons, stable interfaces across files, and iterative debugging of cross-file inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose CodeTeam, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that separates planning, decision making, and implementation into distinct, coordinated stages. In the planning stage, multiple Architect agents draft competing software design sketches (SDSs), optionally grounded by retrieved design references. A cto (Chief Technical Officer) agent then evaluates, selects, and normalizes the most promising SDS into a machine-checkable contract that specifies file ownership, public interfaces, and dependency constraints. In the implementation stage, Developer agents generate code

translated_title: CodeTeam：一个基于大语言模型的多智能体仓库级代码生成框架
translated_abstract: 自然语言到仓库生成（NL2Repo）要求系统能够根据自然语言需求文档构建一个完整的软件仓库。与函数级代码生成相比，该任务需要更长的规划视野、跨文件稳定的接口，以及对跨文件不一致问题的迭代调试。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CodeTeam，这是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，它将规划、决策和实现分离为各自独立且相互协调的阶段。在规划阶段，多个Architect（架构师）智能体起草相互竞争的软件设计草图（SDS），并可选择性地以检索到的设计参考资料作为依据。随后，cto（首席技术官）智能体对这些SDS进行评估、选择和规范化，将最有前景的SDS转化为机器可校验的契约，该契约明确规定了文件归属、公共接口和依赖约束。在实现阶段，Developer（开发者）智能体生成代码。
tldr: CodeTeam是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，通过将规划、决策与实现划分为独立协调的阶段——由多个架构师智能体竞争起草设计草图、CTO智能体将其规范化为机器可校验的契约、开发者智能体据此生成代码——来完成仓库级代码生成任务。
en_tdlr: CodeTeam is an LLM-based multi-agent framework for repository-level code generation that separates planning, decision-making, and implementation into coordinated stages, where competing Architect agents draft designs, a CTO agent normalizes the best one into a machine-checkable contract, and Developer agents generate the code.
